The most common terms in the Hottentot language for ‘brother’ are ‘Bra’ or ‘Brae’, and ‘Nooi’, or ‘Nooi-ing’, but these were adopted by Dutch settlers from Hottentots who spoke Dutch. By 1848, a tendency toward substitution of the Dutch word for ‘brother’, i.e., ‘broer’, which has the same pronunciation as ‘Bra’, was noted, and the English Hottentots began to use the word Bra (‘brow-er’) almost exclusively to designate a person of their own sex.
